subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw solve the canonical stranded `message_tool_only` final issue with this PR's default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config, or with the newer default-recovery/no-new-config direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 after that branch is refreshed?
rationale: Both branches address the same message-loss class but make different product and privacy-boundary choices, and the successor PR is open rather than a merged safe supersession.

options.title: Pick one canonical recovery path first
options.body: Maintainers should choose the intended recovery policy, then require redacted real transport proof on the chosen branch before merge.

options.title: Proceed with this opt-in config
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate if maintainers explicitly approve a new root config option and the contributor adds real transport proof.

options.title: Pause for the successor branch
options.body: If maintainers prefer default recovery without a new config surface, wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536 to become the clean canonical path before closing this PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Pick one canonical recovery path first
recommendation.body: Maintainers should choose the intended recovery policy, then require redacted real transport proof on the chosen branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core config, auto-reply delivery, and message-tool privacy policy, and this handle is the strongest history signal on the diagnostics-only predecessor.
